origine_fr: Le Shuowen jiezi glose 契 « grand accord » et l'analyse par 大, grand, et 㓞, des entailles faites au couteau. En haut, 丰 garde les encoches et 刀 le couteau : on taillait l'accord dans le bois. Le contrat, 契约, et l'entente, 默契, en viennent.
origine_en: The Shuowen jiezi glosses 契 as “a great agreement” and analyses it as 大, great, and 㓞, notches cut with a knife. At the top, 丰 keeps the notches and 刀 the knife: agreements were carved in wood. The contract, 契约, and tacit understanding, 默契, come from it.
